source: Oy Matkahuolto Ab, Lavarahtihinnasto terminaalista vastaanottajalle (pallet freight price list, terminal to recipient)
source_location_note: the task named the Matkahuolto home page, which prints no tariff. the Lavarahti service page, https://www.matkahuolto.fi/yrityksille/pakettipalvelut/toimitukset-yritykselta-yritykselle/isot-paketit-ja-lavarahti, describes the service and its limits but prints no prices. the tariff below was read from Matkahuolto's published Lavarahti price list pdf named in source_url
page_or_section: page 1 weight x distance freight table; page 2 'Lavarahdin nouto' pickup table; page 3 section 1.1 pricing rules and fuel surcharge wording; service limits from the Lavarahti service page
role: upper-bound calibration evidence for F_i and alpha_i
unit: EUR per shipment by chargeable-weight bracket and road-distance band
access_date_basis: no price values were supplied with the task for this source; the tariff was read on this date from the price list named in source_url
reverification_status: read from the published price list; given url has no tariff

unit_basis.value: per shipment by chargeable-weight bracket (kg, with a pallet-metre equivalent column) and road-distance band (km), terminal to recipient; chargeable weight is the greater of actual weight and cubic weight 1 m3 = 333 kg, or pallet-metre weight 1 lvm = 1850 kg when nothing can be loaded on top
unit_basis.source_wording: Lavarahdin veloitus perustuu kilometreihin ja rahdituspainoon. ... Kuutiopaino 1 m3 = 333 kg ... Lavametri (lvm) 1 lvm = 1850 kg (pituus x leveys / 2,4m)

fuel_surcharge_treatment.source_wording: Lavarahdin polttoainelisä tarkistetaan viikoittain ja astuu voimaan maanantaisin. ... Kulloinkin voimassa oleva polttoainelisä on nähtävillä Matkahuollon verkkosivuilla.

pickup_treatment.value: not included in the freight table; pickup is always part of the service and is priced separately on page 2
pickup_treatment.source_wording: Rahtihinta sisältää kuljetuksen terminaalista vastaanottajalle minne tahansa Suomessa, noutohinta esitetty erikseen. Palveluun kuuluu aina nouto

service_limits_as_printed: Lavarahti on palvelumme yli 35 kg tai isokokoisille lähetyksille.
Lähetyksen yksittäisen paketin enimmäispaino on 1200 kg
Lähetyksen kokonaistilavuus voi olla enintään 9 m3
table_interpretation_note: the pdf text layer yields the distance header as two rows of band bounds and prefixes each price row with its weight bracket and pallet-metre bracket. the 1400 km bound is printed twice, as the upper bound of the 1350 band and the lower bound of the 1400 band, and is kept as printed. the table extends to 14999 kg while the service page caps a shipment at 3000 kg; both are recorded as printed
verification_note: upper-bound calibration evidence for heavier shipments outside ordinary parcel weight limits; record the actual tariff structure found, do not assume it matches Posti's zone count or unit types
